summary: Owned units s0322–s0344 are the chapter-end calligraphy 贊. No owned sentence names a birth, death, age, ruler, reign, era, month, or day. The Chinese never writes 東漢後期, 曹魏, 東晉, or 南朝梁; those parenthetical sourceDate labels are extractor glosses. 伯英臨池 and 師宜懸帳 are recalled as vanished marvels (無復餘蹤 / 罕有遺跡). 鐘擅美一時 and 子雲近出 mark relative reputation, not calendar endpoints. 王逸少 is praised as the unique master, and 獻之 is judged against his father, still without years. 臥王濛於紙中 and 坐徐偃於筆下 are metaphors inside the critique of 子雲, not events those two men performed. Every dated attestation copies a traditional lifespan (168–192, 168–189, 151–230, 303–361, 344–386, 487–549, 309–347) and treats that span as an activity window. Endpoints have no owner-event justification in the passage: a window must state uncertainty about one event, not years of a life or a dynasty, and later reception must not feed life dates or active hints. The 贊 itself is also undated, so the reception cannot be given a Western year from these units. Active hints merely repeat the same unsupported spans, including legendary antiquity for 徐偃. Person records are therefore incoherent with the sealed evidence. The supplied sourceUrl returned 404; this review uses only the sealed unit texts. No conversion or competing source-date reading arises, because the Chinese supplies no date to convert.
